ABOUT.title: About G-TEC
ABOUT.text: G-TEC Computer Education is an **ISO 9001:2015 certified** global training powerhouse with over **25 years of excellence**, present in 20+ countries with 1.8M+ alumni. We specialize in job-oriented IT and vocational skill development.

CENTRE_INFO.title: Madurai Anna Nagar Centre
CENTRE_INFO.text:
📍 **G-TEC Madurai Anna Nagar Centre**:
• Address: Idhayam Complex No.416, 2nd Floor, 2nd East Main Road, New LIG Colony, Anna Nagar, Madurai – 625020
• Phone: 9025046473
• Hours: Mon–Sat: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM

CONTACT.title: Contact & Admissions
CONTACT.text: Have questions regarding admissions, batch timings, or course fees? Reach our Madurai centre at **9025046473** or submit your inquiry online.

COURSES.title: Course Catalog
COURSES.text: G-TEC provides recognized certification diplomas across Software, Hardware & Networking, Web Development, Graphic Design, Digital Marketing, and Accounting.

COURSE_RECOMMENDATION.title: Find My Course
COURSE_RECOMMENDATION.text: Let's find your perfect course! I'll take you to our Find My Course page — answer 4 quick questions and we'll match you to the right course.

DIGITAL_MARKETING.title: Digital Marketing Master
DIGITAL_MARKETING.text: Our **Digital Marketing Master Course** covers Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Google Search & Display Ads (SEM), Social Media Marketing, Content Strategy, and Analytics.

GALLERY.title: Campus & Lab Gallery
GALLERY.text: Take a virtual tour of our high-tech computer labs, modern air-conditioned classrooms, student project presentations, and award events!

GRAPHIC_DESIGN.title: Graphic & UI/UX Design
GRAPHIC_DESIGN.text: Master creative software including Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, CorelDraw, and UI/UX design fundamentals with portfolio projects.

GREETING.title: Welcome to G-TEC
GREETING.text: Hello! 👋 I'm G-TEC Buddy, your AI guide! You can ask me to navigate anywhere on the website, find course syllabi, or get centre details.

GTEC_FACTS.title: G-TEC Highlights
GTEC_FACTS.text:
⭐ **Why Choose G-TEC?**
• **25+ Years** of International Heritage
• **1.8+ Million** Alumni Worldwide
• Present in **20+ Countries**
• **ISO 9001:2015 Certified** Curriculum
• Practical hands-on training with 100% placement support.

HARDWARE_NETWORKING.title: Hardware & Networking
HARDWARE_NETWORKING.text: Gain hands-on skills in **PC Hardware & Maintenance**, **Cisco CCNA Prep**, and **Diploma in CCTV Installation (DCI)** in our practical networking labs.

HOME.title: Home Page
HOME.text: Navigating to the G-TEC home page featuring campus video tours, certified courses, and student success reviews.

LEADERSHIP.title: Leadership & Mentors
LEADERSHIP.text: G-TEC Madurai Anna Nagar is led by certified technical directors and expert faculty committed to student mentorship and career transformation.

MS_OFFICE.title: MS Office & Computer Basics
MS_OFFICE.text: Our **MS Office & Computer Basics (DCA)** program teaches Microsoft Word, Advanced Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Charts), PowerPoint, and essential digital office tools.

PLACEMENT_SUPPORT.title: 100% Placement Assistance
PLACEMENT_SUPPORT.text:
🎯 **Career Support & Placements**:
• Dedicated placement coordinator
• Resume writing & LinkedIn profile optimization
• Mock technical interviews & soft skills training
• On-campus & corporate interview referrals.

TALLY.title: Tally Prime & Financial Accounting
TALLY.text: Master computerized accounting with **Tally Prime with GST**, E-way billing, Inventory Management, Payroll, and **SAP FICO** with live business case studies.

TRAINERS.title: Certified Faculty & Trainers
TRAINERS.text: At G-TEC, all courses are conducted by certified industry professionals with extensive practical experience in software, finance, multimedia, and hardware.

WEB_DEVELOPMENT.title: Web & Full Stack Development
WEB_DEVELOPMENT.text: Become a Full Stack Web Developer! Master **HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Python, Django, React**, database integration, and Git portfolio deployment.

AFFILIATIONS.title: Our Global Affiliations
AFFILIATIONS.text: G-TEC is proud to be affiliated with premier global technology giants and certifying bodies including **Tally, SAP, Adobe, Cisco, Autodesk, EC-Council, Meta, Certiport, Keltron, and ABMA UK**.
